beaconsoftware-beaconsoftware:ashbyhq:6b.title: Growth Lead
beaconsoftware-beaconsoftware:ashbyhq:6b.description: ABOUT BEACON SOFTWARE Beacon Software is a permanent capital holding company which acquires and grows essential businesses. We are a profitable Series C firm that combines great technologists, operators and M&A professionals to accelerate the scale of the ambition of the dozens of businesses we own and operate. We are supported by capital from tier-1 venture capital, crossover, and endowment investors as well as the founders of the leading technology companies from the past decade. We are growing our team in Toronto, San Francisco, and New York. Apply below. You’ll be joining Beacon’s Acceleration team: a cross-functional group of Product Managers, Engineers, Designers, GTM experts, and Data Scientists. We work closely with portfolio companies to solve problems, create and implement playbooks, and build new features and products. ABOUT THE ROLE Beacon Software buys businesses. You get to grow them. Specifically, you’ll design and run go-to-market experiments for a pod of 3-4 companies we’ve acquired in a particular industry (education, industrials, parks & rec, etc). This can take any shape: you might launch ads, cross-sell into other portfolio companies, game plan a conference, scrape high-intent lead lists, write copy, or vibe-code a dashboard. To put it another way, you’ll be a fractional head of growth, with an eye towards systems and playbooks that generalize across portfolio companies. We’re looking for an animal who can go into a business, ask the right questions with little context, launch experiments, and drive revenue. Basically, we’re looking for The Wolf https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yOZB6mNqhuA, but for growth. WHY WOULD YOU WANT THIS ROLE? - Get a first-person view into the world of private equity, rollups, and AI. - Access proprietary learnings about vertical SaaS businesses in a variety of industries. - Work with a team of former YC founders, growth leaders, and execs at Silicon Valley’s fastest-growing companies (Instacart, AngelList, Retool, and more). - Have loads of control and autonomy over what you work on. - Be artsy AND sciencey. - Like writing copy and brainstorming video ideas? You get to do that. - Like reading investment memos and deeply understanding businesses? You get to do that, too. - Ample LLM token budget. - Meaningful equity in a hyperscaler that’s already profitable. YOUR FUTURE TEAMMATES - Asher https://www.linkedin.com/in/akingabramson/: Former cofounder of Demand Curve (YC S19). Has grown multiple startups to millions in annual revenue. - Safwaan https://www.linkedin.com/in/safwaan/: Former EIR & investor at Founders Inc., former Chief of Staff to a well-known entrepreneur - Brent https://www.linkedin.com/in/brent-jensen/: Former growth @Together Software (YC S19) & Roadmunk, both companies acquired for 8-figure sums. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES - Meet with your pod leader and portfolio company GMs, marrying product direction with user learnings to brainstorm growth experiments. - Prioritize, build, and launch experiments that meaningfully drive revenue. - Identify and optimize growth loops at portfolio companies. - Track and improve conversion at every major step of the marketing funnel. - Build systems (e.g., playbooks, Claude skills, mini-products) that less technical GMs and portfolio company employees can use to run GTM experiments themselves. - Hire other great growth people. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Former founders and growth marketers/GTM engineers with a track record of cracking growth channels and loops, ideally in B2B SaaS. - Strong growth fundamentals: prioritizing channels, breaking down funnels, developing ICPs, automating prospecting and leadgen, copywriting, CRO, etc. - Clear, concise writing. - Comfort saying no to the wrong priorities. - Enough vibe-coding chops to be dangerous, but not a man-with-a-hammer. - Software engineering or finance background is a plus, but not required. getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:43fbd901-d42.title: Sales Enablement Trainer
getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:43fbd901-d42.description: Wing Assistant is hiring a hands on Sales Enablement Trainer to level up our sales team — not with generic intro decks, but by improving the actual emails, calls, and cadences our reps use every day. This is a coach who has carried a quota and closed, and uses that credibility to make real, measurable improvements on the floor. If your first instinct when a deal stalls is "let me see the thread and the call recording" — read on.
responsibilities: Sit in the calls — live and recorded — and find exactly where deals are being lost.
Rewrite the copy, scripts, and sequences that aren't converting, and prove the new version works.
A/B test sales emails, call openers, demo pitches, and tactics like personalized video — keep the winners, kill the losers.
Build and tune outbound cadences so reps follow up at the right time, on the right channel, with the right message.
Coach reps one-on-one on real calls and build the objection-handling playbook for our market — then drill it until it's reflexive.
Produce a video training series and self-serve modules with assessments, so new reps ramp fast and tenured reps keep sharpening.
qualifications: You'll thrive here if you
Have personally sold and closed — ideally outbound/high-volume B2B — and can show your numbers.
Write sales copy that converts and can explain  why  it works.
Are comfortable on camera and can produce clean training videos without a production team.
Can structure an A/B test, read the result honestly, and make the call.
Coach without crushing — you leave reps better and more confident.
Move fast: a diagnosis becomes a usable fix in hours, not weeks.
Know your way around a CRM (Hubspot plus) and a sales sequencing tool.
Nice to have

Experience in virtual staffing, BPO, or managed services · Pipedrive or CRM automations · video editing · sequencing tools (Apollo, Outreach, Salesloft, Instantly, Smartlead) · prior sales enablement assets (playbooks, battle cards, certification programs).

jobgether-jobgether:lever:1dae5f1f-5c52-.title: Data Center Supply Planning Lead
jobgether-jobgether:lever:1dae5f1f-5c52-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Data Center Supply Planning Lead based in the United States. This is a high-impact role responsible for shaping supply planning across a rapidly expanding portfolio of data center infrastructure. You will connect compute and accelerator supply, capacity targets, site pipelines, delivery schedules, and operational readiness into one integrated planning view. Your work will directly influence which infrastructure opportunities are prioritized, how sites are configured, and how resources are allocated. You will build forecasts, scenarios, and planning mechanisms that internal teams and external partners can confidently execute against. The role sits at the intersection of supply chain, infrastructure delivery, technical program management, engineering, and demand planning. You will operate in a fast-moving, highly cross-functional environment where strong analytical thinking, systems design, and influence are essential. This is an opportunity to build scalable planning processes and tools that support the growth of next-generation AI infrastructure. Build and maintain an integrated data center supply forecast covering committed and pipeline capacity by site, design, accelerator type, and delivery tranche against evolving growth targets. Establish and continuously refine the planning assumptions, models, and frameworks that underpin the infrastructure supply portfolio. Support recurring portfolio reviews by providing a clear view of supply status, key decisions, risks, dependencies, and downstream impacts. Partner with technical program management, delivery, and demand planning teams to keep hall readiness, installation plans, accelerator supply, and delivery schedules synchronized. Develop scenarios to evaluate the impact of changes to delivery dates, accelerator tranches, capacity targets, or other planning assumptions, and develop analytical solutions to close identified gaps. Determine which long-lead resources should be held in inventory to create strategic flexibility and establish principles for how those resources should be allocated. Define and improve the process through which new data center sites enter delivery tracking and ensure schedule changes are communicated effectively across downstream teams. Help establish and evolve a delivery planning system of record, partnering with internal tooling teams to translate planning requirements into scalable systems and workflows. Drive continuous improvement across supply planning processes, cadence, data quality, forecasting, and portfolio management practices. Proactively identify supply risks, constraints, and opportunities across functions and influence cross-functional partners toward timely resolution. Translate complex planning analysis into clear recommendations that support infrastructure investment, prioritization, and operational decisions. Requirements: Demonstrated experience leading supply planning, capacity planning, or portfolio management for data centers, power infrastructure, or similarly capital-intensive environments. Strong understanding of the full data center build lifecycle, including acquisition, design, sourcing, construction, commissioning, and deployment. Proven experience architecting supply planning processes and establishing operating cadences with a focus on continuous improvement. Experience redesigning delivery, deployment, or infrastructure planning processes at scale and demonstrating measurable improvements. Strong analytical and quantitative capabilities, including experience building planning models, scenarios, forecasting tools, allocation frameworks, or optimization solutions. Ability to develop automated planning tools and workflows, including leveraging AI-assisted development where appropriate. jobgether-jobgether:lever:7dcfed0b-6d41-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Lead ML/AI Platform Engineer based in Germany. As a Lead ML/AI Platform Engineer, you will own the infrastructure that moves machine learning and AI from experimentation into reliable production systems. You will define technical direction for ML/AI architecture, tooling, standards, and platform strategy while partnering closely with data science, DevOps, backend engineering, product, and leadership teams. The role spans managed AWS machine learning services, open-source ML tooling, model serving, inference pipelines, and production integrations. You will also drive the engineering strategy for GenAI, LLMs, retrieval architectures, and agentic workflows. Your decisions will establish the foundation for future AI-powered products in a highly regulated financial technology environment. This is a fully remote independent contractor opportunity within a globally distributed team, with reliable overlap with US Pacific business hours. Own the ML/AI platform: Lead the architecture and operation of training infrastructure, model serving, inference pipelines, model registries, feature pipelines, and production integrations. Set technical direction: Partner with the Data Platform Architect to define ML/AI architecture, engineering standards, tooling strategies, and build-versus-buy decisions. Build production ML systems: Oversee feature engineering, model training, tuning, registration, deployment, monitoring, and hosted inference using AWS managed services and open-source tooling. Establish MLOps practices: Drive model monitoring, drift detection, reproducibility, experiment tracking, model registries, and cost observability in collaboration with DevOps. Shape the ML roadmap: Work with product, data, and engineering leadership to identify high-impact AI/ML opportunities and translate them into actionable technical roadmaps. Provide technical leadership: Mentor senior engineers, guide complex architectural decisions, and represent the AI/ML function in cross-functional discussions. Communicate technical strategy: Translate complex architectural trade-offs into clear design documents and executive-level recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Requirements: Senior engineering experience: 8+ years in software or ML engineering, including at least 5 years delivering production machine learning systems and owning complex, ambiguous problems end to end. Technical leadership: Demonstrated experience shaping ML strategy, mentoring senior engineers, and serving as a trusted decision-maker for challenging architectural problems. AWS ML expertise: Hands-on experience with Amazon SageMaker for training, tuning, hosted endpoints, and model registry, as well as Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore for GenAI and agentic applications. Open-source ML tooling: Practical experience with JupyterLab, Spark, MLflow, and related machine learning development and experimentation tools. Our partner is looking for a Scheduling Team Lead based in United States. This role is an opportunity to support a growing scheduling operation within a healthcare services environment. You will serve as a key resource for scheduling staff, helping teams meet productivity, accuracy, and service expectations. The position combines day-to-day scheduling responsibilities with team coordination, performance monitoring, problem-solving, and process improvement. You will work closely with department leadership to identify operational challenges and implement practical solutions. The role also provides opportunities to contribute to training initiatives, special projects, and workflow improvements. It is well suited to an organized and proactive professional who enjoys supporting colleagues while maintaining high standards of customer service and confidentiality. Support, guide, and coordinate scheduling staff to ensure daily assignments are completed accurately, efficiently, and on time. Monitor scheduler productivity and performance, providing regular updates and relevant insights to department leadership. jobgether-jobgether:lever:c28e059d-e51e-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Mobile Application Engineering Manager based in the United States. This is a senior engineering leadership role focused on building reliable, mission-critical mobile applications that support first responders. You will lead and grow a team of mobile engineers while providing technical direction across iOS, Android, and hybrid mobile technologies. The role combines hands-on technical expertise with people management, architecture, roadmap planning, and cross-functional collaboration. You will partner closely with Product and other stakeholders to translate customer needs into a clear development roadmap and high-quality releases. A key focus will be building scalable, secure, offline-first mobile experiences where reliability and performance are essential. You will also establish engineering best practices, mentor technical talent, and guide strategic decisions around native versus cross-platform development. As the community's primary voice, you will foster meaningful conversations while creating scalable engagement through content, events, and recognition programs. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Customer Success teams to ensure developer perspectives influence products and experiences. southparkcommons-boom-supersonic:ripplin.title: Senior Brand Designer
southparkcommons-boom-supersonic:ripplin.description: This isn’t your standard design role. At Boom, we aren’t just building a brand; we are building the future of human connection by bringing back supersonic flight. We’ve already made history with XB-1, and now we are scaling that breakthrough across Overture, Symphony, and Superpower. We need a Senior Brand Designer who is a "concept-to-execution" powerhouse—someone who can bridge the gap between high-altitude creative vision and the granular reality of physical production. The Mission As a senior member of our creative team, you will be the primary steward of the Boom brand. You will translate our multi-program mission into a tangible, world-class experience that lives across our manufacturing facilities, digital platforms, and every global brand touchpoint. You aren’t here to just "slap a logo" on things; you are here to design the systems, the physical objects, and the visual stories of our technical progress that define a supersonic renaissance. What You’ll Do Design for Impact: From high-fidelity digital assets to facility graphics and premium, non-traditional "wow" gifts, you will own the visual output of the company. Establish the Standard: You will build the master templates, style guides, and design systems that allow our brand to scale without losing its soul. Master the Details: You’ll spend time on our shop floor and in our test facilities, working alongside engineers to turn complex technical data into accurate, beautiful, and refined visual communications of our engineering milestones. Command the Craft: You’ll manage elite vendor relationships, performing press checks and material tests to ensure that every physical object Boom produces meets our "Supersonic Wow" bar. Who You Are A Brand Steward: You have the backbone to protect our standards. You are the definitive authority on how the Boom brand shows up in the world, and you’re comfortable navigating the tension between "fast" and "right" to ensure we never compromise on quality. An Intentional Creator: You value restraint. You understand that negative space and clean typography are as powerful as a full-bleed render. You build "Elevated Design," prioritizing sophistication and hierarchy over visual clutter. Technically Precise: You don’t wait for a brief. You have a discerning eye for detail and a relentless curiosity. You’ll dive deep into CAD drawings or mechanical specs to ensure every technical element in your design is accurate and intentional. A System-Builder: You think in frameworks. You take pride in organized asset libraries and naming conventions because you know that a small, fast team requires an impeccable digital foundation to scale. Why Boom? History in the Making: You will look back and say you were there when the world went supersonic again. High-Stakes, High-Reward: We move in 3-week Agile sprints. You will see your work move from your screen to the physical world faster than anywhere else. The Best Work of Your Career: This is an onsite, "maker-first" role in our Denver HQ. You’ll be surrounded by the world's most ambitious engineers and creators in our state-of-the-art facilities. Are you ready to build the visual identity of supersonic flight? Let’s chat. Compensation The Base Salary Range for this position is $138,979-$175,768 per year. Actual salaries will vary based on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of Boom’s total rewards package for employees. Other rewards may include long-term incentives/equity, a flexible PTO policy, and many other progressive benefits. There is no set deadline to apply for this job opportunity. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the search is no longer active.
